predecessors.name: Huns
predecessors.text: Pannonia, the Hunnic land the Ostrogoths held after Attila's sons lost it at Nedao (454)

predecessors.name: Kingdom of Odoacer
predecessors.text: Odoacer's realm at his death: Italy with Sicily but not Sardinia, and Dalmatia

successors.name: Ostrogothic Kingdom
successors.text: Italy and the lands held with it, from Cliopatria's Ostrogothic Kingdom row

ledger.x: 473/474: the Goths settle on East Roman soil as federates, not as conquerors.

479: Epirus. 'Theodoric settled his people in Epirus in 479 with the help of his relative Sidimund.' A federate settlement on imperial soil, like Moesia, not a cession: eastern-roman-empire has no 479 loss. The page does not say when the Goths left Epirus (raid on Greece and Larissa 482, command of Dacia Ripensis and…
autumn 488: the Goths march for Italy.
autumn 488: the same march ends the federate settlement in Epirus (held coarsely from 479, see the 479 event).
28 August 489: the Ostrogoths cross the Julian Alps.
493: the capital is Ravenna (Ostrogothic Kingdom page: 'Ravenna (493-540)').
493: Theodoric founds the Ostrogothic Kingdom in Italy.
493: Sicily follows Odoacer's realm to Theodoric (bridging).
493: Dalmatia follows Odoacer's realm to Theodoric (bridging).
5 March 493: Theodoric enters Ravenna and becomes master of Italy.
March 493: the war for Italy ends.
499: Cliopatria's Ostrogoths row ends and its Ostrogothic Kingdom row begins at 500.

wars.name: Battle of Nedao
wars.outcome: Hunnic dominance in Central and Eastern Europe is broken; the Ostrogoths gain independence by the early 460s and later become federates of the Eastern Roman Empire.

wars.name: Battle of Bolia
wars.outcome: 'Eventual Gothic victory at the Battle of Bolia in 469, now under Theodemir'; the Theodemir page: 'a Roman imperial army was defeated and chased away from Pannonia' in 469.

wars.name: Gothic wars in the Balkans
wars.outcome: Theodoric Strabo is declared king in 473; the Amal Goths settle in Epirus (479), raid Greece and sack Larissa (482), command Dacia Ripensis and Moesia Inferior (483), blockade Constantinople (487) and march for Italy on Zeno's commission (autumn 488).

wars.name: Ostrogothic defeat of the Gepids at Sirmium
wars.outcome: The Gepids were 'defeated at Sirmium in August 489' on the way to Italy; the Goths took Pannonia and Sirmium only in 504-505.

wars.name: Odoacer-Theodoric war
wars.outcome: Isonzo (28 August 489), Verona (September 489), Faenza (a defeat, 490), the Adda (11 August 490); a siege of Ravenna to the treaty of February 493, Theodoric's entry on 5 March and Odoacer's killing on 15 March.

certainty.note: A migrating people on federate land: Pannonia, Moesia and Epirus were never bounded by a frontier line.
Italy's limits are those of Odoacer's kingdom; the page names no surveyed frontier.
